readme:
# Raphael, Lord of Wisdom A **client-side** V Rising UI that turns the chat commands of popular **server-side** mods into buttons, forms, and on-screen overlays. Each mod's tabs appear only when that mod is detected on your server — so it works whether your server runs one, several, or none. **Works with:** Bloodcraft · Beelzebub · Uriel · Faust · Nyarlathotep · KindredCommands · KindredLogistics — plus a standalone tabbed chat window that works on **any** server. > 🟣 **Formerly BloodCraftHub** — same mod, renamed. Switching over? See **[Migrating from BloodCraftHub](#migrating-from-bloodcrafthub)** and **don't run both at once.** > > ⚠️ **Pre-1.0 beta.** It's daily-driven on a live server, but you may hit rough edges. The fastest way to get a fix is the **[Shadow Realm Discord](https://discord.gg/c4YU2HbHFA)**. --- ## What you get - **One panel for your server's mods** — left-rail tab groups for Bloodcraft, Kindred, Beelzebub, Uriel, Faust, and Nyarlathotep; each shows only when detected. - **Commands as forms** — player pickers, dropdowns, and number fields instead of typing `.lvl set ` into chat. - **Live HUD overlays** — XP, familiar, weapon/blood, professions, quests, shift-spell cooldown, and more. Each is draggable, resizable, and individually toggleable. - **Standalone chat window** — tabbed per-channel chat (Global / Local / Clan / Whispers / System), whisper anyone online, custom colors, and per-channel history controls (keep conversation, drop noisy System floods). Needs no server mods. - **Chat & Diagnostics in one place** — choose what Raphael hides from chat and what it logs, for itself and every server mod. Presets: Quiet, Normal, Show everything. Replies to commands you send always show. - **Complete in-game guides** — one guide per mod (Bloodcraft, Beelzebub, Uriel, Faust, Nyarlathotep, Kindred) with a quick start, how it works, every player and admin command, every server setting with its default, and troubleshooting, so nobody needs GitHub or Thunderstore to play or run a server. Plus a "V Rising Basics" tab for the base game. - **Admin tooling** — surfaced wherever the backing mod provides it: Bloodcraft forms and a one-click **Reset Bloodcraft progress**, Kindred admin, Beelzebub ability shaping and lock groups, Faust server analytics, Uriel sharing/spawning, Castle Events units and server controls (feature switches, Restore vanilla), Nyarlathotep event control.
Full feature list - **Floating Raphael + OV buttons** (top-right) — open the panel; OV is a master overlay show/hide (with optional timed auto-reappear and launcher hiding). - **Tab groups** (each appears only when its server mod is detected): - **Bloodcraft** — Familiars, Boxes, V-Bloods, All Familiars, Class, Weapon Expertise, Blood Legacy, Unarmed + Shift, Prestige, Levels, Daily Quests, Admin. - **Kindred** — Logistics (+ admin), Commands, Admin: Players / Server / World. - **Beelzebub** — Bestiary, Loadout (universal + per-weapon + per-form ability sets), Hotkeys, Transforms, Settings, admin Config / Players. - **Faust** — Castle Info, Open/All Plots, Decay Watch, Castle Resources, Player Info, Clans, Player Positions, Server Stats, **Boss Status**, **Leaderboards**, **World Map**, admin Control / Oversight. - **Uriel** — Storage Sharing, Prisons, Stairs, Object Spawning, Object Catalog, **Castle Events** (alpha: drop mob and boss markers, bind doors, start and time runs with a live readout and on-screen notices), **Event Library** (squads, floor templates, templates), Settings, admin Sharing / Objects / **Controls** (which features are on, and Stop all events / Remove all units / Remove all objects / Restore vanilla) / **Units**. A feature the server switched off is greyed with the reason, never hidden. - **Nyarlathotep** — Live Events (regions, wave countdowns, on-screen notices), Settings, admin Events (with an inline form editor per event: per-wave units, bosses, unit pools and pursuit, destination waves, infestations and horde marches, and a searchable unit list) / **Units** (event units near you with positions) / Templates / Pillars / Announce / Kill Switch. Leaderboards, My Stats and Zones are ready for when Nyarlathotep adds them. - **Settings & Help** — Quick Start, one complete **guide per mod**, **V Rising Basics** (in-built base-game guide), Game Guide (external links), Settings, **Chat & Diagnostics**, About. - **Secondary overlays** (toggle from the footer) — XP, Familiar, Familiar Browser, Daily Quest, Professions, Shift Spell, a Combined info overlay, Quick Actions, a Familiar Quick Spawn overlay, and a Faust Boss Tracker. Each is independently draggable/resizable with its own transparency; visibility persists across sessions. - **Freeze actions while the UI is open** (opt-in) — stop moving/attacking/casting and block menu hotkeys while you click around the panel. - **"Last server response" panel** — replies to read-data commands (`.wep get`, `.class l`, …) show in-UI, not just in chat. - **Live data** via Bloodcraft's signed broadcast protocol, with chat-regex fallback for replies it doesn't cover. - **Fast opening** — the panel opens right away; tabs fill in without freezing the game. - **Refresh button** (panel footer, bottom-right; also Settings → Connection) — clears chat history and stale UI caches without touching settings. Use it if the game feels slower after a long session. - **Quality of life** — hover tooltips on every control, auto-resizing panel, scrollable tabs + left rail, a two-zone color theme, a 50–400% text-size slider, and opt-in keyboard hotkeys.
--- ## Install Client-side only — install on the **player's** V Rising client, not the server. **Mod manager (recommended):** in Thunderstore Mod Manager or r2modman, open your V Rising profile → search **Raphael** → Install. Make sure **BepInExPack_V_Rising** is in the same profile, then launch from the manager. **Manual:** install BepInEx for V Rising, drop `Raphael.dll` into `BepInEx/plugins/`, launch. On your first connect to a modded server, a floating **Raphael** button appears top-right. Hover any control to see what it does (the description shows in the footer). Non-admin commands work for everyone; admin tabs need permissions. --- ## ⚠️ Before you install
Running Eclipse? (compatibility needs re-testing) Historically, Raphael + [Eclipse](https://thunderstore.io/c/v-rising/p/zfolmt/Eclipse/) crashed the client on load (the fault is in Eclipse's HUD code, not Raphael). When Raphael detects Eclipse it stands down from its own passive Bloodcraft layer to avoid the crash: **Eclipse** drives the live HUD, while Raphael keeps its command buttons and chat window. Eclipse has since updated and this hasn't been re-verified — **disable Eclipse while running Raphael to be safe.**
Raphael looks empty on a Bloodcraft server? Raphael's live HUD and Bloodcraft tabs are driven by Bloodcraft's broadcast, which only runs when the server enables at least one of: **Leveling**, **Legacy**, **Expertise**, **Class**, or **Familiar** systems. A Quests-only / Professions-only server won't engage it — click the **Bloodcraft** header for an in-panel diagnostic with a one-click **Force-enable tabs** button (chat commands still work; live overlays stay empty until the server broadcasts).
Controller / gamepad There are known edge cases when V Rising's controller input meets the Raphael UI (e.g. a face button re-opening the panel after a waypoint teleport). A first-pass fix is in; more testing is ongoing. If something opens/closes/focuses on the wrong button, please report it on Discord with repro steps.

changelog:
# Changelog — Raphael, Lord of Wisdom

*Player-facing highlights, newest first. Full per-patch detail lives in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KDavidP1987/Raphael-Lord-of-Wisdom/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
Raphael was formerly **BloodCraftHub** (v0.1–v0.30).*

**Current: v0.73.0** (pre-1.0 beta).

---

## 0.73.0 — Complete in-game guides and a Bloodcraft progress reset

Works with Bloodcraft 1.13.26, Nyarlathotep 0.14.0 and Uriel 0.22.0.

- Every mod now has one complete guide under Settings and Help (Bloodcraft, Beelzebub, Uriel, Faust, Nyarlathotep,
  Kindred): a quick start, how it works, every player and admin command, server settings with defaults, and
  troubleshooting. Wrong commands in the old guides are fixed.
- Admins: **Reset Bloodcraft progress** (Bloodcraft → Admin) resets a player's prestige, weapon expertise, blood
  legacies, professions and level, one checked command at a time, with pause, retry, skip and stop. Works for offline
  players.
- Nyarlathotep 0.14.0 undead hordes: the event editor has forms for **Infestation** and **Horde march** events, and
  a Destination card for spawn waves. Unit counts go up to 500, and templates get an Undead hordes group.
- Uriel 0.22.0: **Admin: Controls** (formerly Admin: Config) shows which Uriel features are switched on and has
  **Stop all events**, **Remove all units**, **Remove all objects** and **Restore vanilla**, each with Arm + Confirm.
  Features the server has switched off are greyed with the reason on every Uriel tab, never hidden.
- Experimental, off by default: an **Emberglass bridge** for servers that send Bloodcraft data over Emberglass, for
  players who also have the Emberglass client installed.
- V Rising Basics tidied up, now covering Nyarlathotep and Uriel's Castle Events.
- Fixed: Kindred admin buttons that sent commands KindredCommands doesn't have (staff, castle hearts, plots, prisoner
  settings); buttons for commands KindredCommands disables are removed. Beelzebub Phase now cycles, and the wipe warning
  and slot list are corrected. Bloodcraft Change class form, the right shard name and prestige reset values. The
  Nyarlathotep editor background stays gray.

## 0.72.0 — Nyarlathotep wave variety and a friendlier event editor

Works with Nyarlathotep 0.13.0-rc.3.

- The event editor is now a form: values are filled in from the server; you pick numbers with - / + and presets within
  the allowed range, and choices with buttons. Changed fields turn gold, saved ones get a ✓, and refused ones show
  why. **Save all changes** and **Undo** sit at the top.
- New in rc.3: a different unit list, bosses and start rule for each wave; named unit pools; fixed and rolled bosses;
  pursuit.
- Templates are grouped, with the new Timed waves and Onslaught sections, and a **Turn Spawns on** button when the
  Spawns pillar is off.
- Fixed: left-rail groups opening by themselves after a text-size change, a late mod detection or a Nyarlathotep
  setting change.
